'''Appazanna Engineering Works''' was based on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the manufacturer of the [[Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft/Legends|Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft]] and the [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamaran]].
